The archive service indexes each new document once and records its source identifier.
The review queue groups documents by project so operators can inspect related changes together.
A successful import includes the document title, its revision number, and a completion timestamp.
Workers preserve completed records when another job on the same service is stopped.
The operator can open a request receipt to inspect the decision and its correlation identifier.
An upstream recorder reports only the arrivals that it actually observed during its measurement window.
A missing recorder leaves the evidence incomplete until its observations can be restored.
A stop boundary affects future admissions while previously admitted requests can finish.
Each new processing run receives a fresh identifier so an older stopped run cannot resume accidentally.
The summary stage completes after every assigned document paragraph has been processed.
